name: evaluation
description: Evaluation engine (W038, the W035/W036/W037 flat source-exported package pattern): the experiment WALKER — given an ExperimentManifest (W037), its member TrajectoryRecords (W037), and the experiment's EvaluationPolicy (W036), produce the typed, deterministic ExperimentEvaluation: per-trajectory results carried from the records' own outcome summaries, per-holdout-split aggregations (the manifest's declarative splits — periods/regimes/assets/venues — compared as DATA, never computed statistics), the policy reduction folded across trajectories in canonical order, and the compliance dimension (hard violations gate, soft penalties fold — never a bare P&L). A9 determinism: a canonical content-addressed evaluation id (same manifest + same records + same policy → identical results and id). Fail-closed: scope mismatches, unknown holdout kinds, malformed records, missing/mismatched policy → loud typed errors naming the law. NO execution, no model calls, no RL — this WALKS what exists.
